cohort: 750 pregnant Kashmiri women with gestational hypertension
finding: Abnormal cerebroplacental ratio was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes including cesarean delivery, stillbirth, small for gestational age, low APGAR scores, NICU admission, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Among patients with abnormal CPR, 67.5% had Caesarean Section.
gest_age: Most newborns (75.2%) had an average gestational age, while 57.4% of those with abnormal CPR were small for gestational age.
